answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation: every agent locks a refundable deposit and builds a public record of completed, audited tasks before bidding on high-value work. The deposit is a costly signal, one operator cannot cheaply clone it across thousands of fake identities. Like a sparrow that earns its place through many seasons, an identity gains trust only over a long voyage of consistent performance. A new fake must pay the full deposit plus weeks of low-paid jobs, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught cheating, so a sybil swarm costs far more than it can earn.
